2607.06306.title: UI2App: Benchmarking Visual Interaction Inference in Executable Web Application Generation
2607.06306.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated growing competence in web page generation. However, existing text-driven approaches rely on complex prompts that impose substantial demands on users and offer limited expressivity for page layout and cross-page visual coherence. Image-driven paradigms, which take UI screenshots as input, align more closely with real development workflows. However, current benchmarks focus primarily on visual fidelity and lack a systematic evaluation of the interaction capabilities in generated artifacts. To address this gap, we introduce UI2App, the first benchmark targeting interaction inference, the ability to recover application behavior from screenshots alone, without any textual or behavioral guidance. UI2App comprises 327 screenshots grouped into 45 state-coherent screenshot sets for runnable multi-route web applications. We design an end-to-end pipeline that evaluates each artifact along four dimensions: executability, navigation reachability, visual fidelity, and interaction inference. The interaction metric (IIS) assesses inferred interactions by functional correctness and state-management complexity, crediting any valid implementation rather than matching a single reference. Experiments on six frontier vision-language models reveal a marked capability mismatch between visual reconstruction and interaction realization: the visual-fidelity leader scores only 7.5 on IIS, ranking fourth and trailing the IIS leader by 5.2x. High-complexity interactions such as cross-page state remain a pervasive bottleneck, with half of the evaluated models scoring exactly zero on this dimension. Overall, the results indicate that inferring complete interaction behavior from static screenshots remains a key challenge for models.
2607.06306.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在網頁生成方面展現出日益增長的能力。<lb/>然而，現有的文本驅動方法依賴於複雜的提示，對用戶提出了相當大的要求，並且在頁面佈局和跨頁面視覺一致性方面提供了有限的表達能力。<lb/>以 UI 截圖為輸入的圖像驅動範式，與實際開發工作流程更為一致。<lb/>然而，目前的基準主要集中在視覺真實度上，缺乏對生成物互動能力的系統評估。<lb/>為了解決這一空白，我們推出了 UI2App，這是首個針對互動推斷的基準，能夠僅從截圖中恢復應用行為，而無需任何文本或行為指導。<lb/>UI2App 包含 327 張截圖，分為 45 組狀態一致的截圖集，用於可運行的多路徑網頁應用程序。<lb/>我們設計了一個端到端的管道，沿著四個維度評估每個生成物：可執行性、導航可達性、視覺真實度和互動推斷。<lb/>互動指標（IIS）通過功能正確性和狀態管理複雜性評估推斷的互動，對任何有效的實現給予認可，而不是僅僅匹配單一參考。<lb/>對六個前沿視覺-語言模型的實驗顯示，視覺重建和互動實現之間存在明顯的能力不匹配：視覺真實度領導者在 IIS 上僅得分 7.5，排名第四，落後於 IIS 領導者 5.2 倍。<lb/>高複雜度的互動，例如跨頁面狀態，仍然是一個普遍的瓶頸，評估的模型中有一半在這一維度上的得分恰好為零。<lb/>總體而言，結果表明，從靜態截圖中推斷完整的互動行為仍然是模型面臨的一個關鍵挑戰。
